name: Paragraphs Stats
description: Generates reports on paragraph types and builds usage metrics.
project_description:
The Paragraphs Stats module is designed to provide content managers and designers with a lens on how Paragraphs are being utilized on a given Drupal site. It is an site auditing tool that allows content maintainers and web designers to see what Paragraphs are being used in what quantities, and the contexts that those Paragraph instances are present on the site. It is particular useful for design and content migration teams that are undertaking either a redesign or structural updates to assess which Paragraphs are in heavy vs light use.

 The first column is a list of all of the Paragraphs that have been configured on the Drupal site. The second column is the machine name for each Paragraph. The remaining columns correspond with the content / node types or other Paragraph contexts that each of the rows (Paragraphs) occur. Where they occur, the number indicates the number of instances of that Paragraph type per context. If there is a non-zero value, it is linked to a list of those occurences. Where "n/a" is listed, these are contexts in which the given Paragraph has not been configured to be associated with the column's content type or alternative Paragraph. Conditional formatting provides a quick visual cue to provide the user with numeric relevancy.
